# Our Approach

## Heteroscedastic Gaussian process
Observations from the simulation are described using by a Gaussian Process:
$$
y(x) \sim \GP(f(x),\sepssq(x))
$$
"COMMENT: Make equation below double column or something"   
$$
f(x) \sim \GP(\mu_f,k_f(x,x'))
$$

$$
\sepsq(x)=\phi(g(x))
$$


$$
g(x) \sim \GP(\mu_g,k_g(x,x'))
$$

$\mu_{(\cdot)}$ is the prior mean function; it's usually constant
$k_{(\cdot)}(x,x)$ is the kernel function.
$\phi(x)$ is a link function to enforce positive noise. We choose $\log$, but *softplus* also works.
